page.overview:
Who is Abacus?

Lord Abacus was the God of Order in the Mortal Kombat comics published by [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malibu_Comics Malibu Comics].

Residing in the Library of Order, Abacus witnessed the chaotic schemes of his fellow god, Zaggot unfold. Despite this being the case, he refused to respond physically as he feared that if he did, it would result in even more chaos to feed Zaggot. However, Abacus changes his mind and meets with Goro, whereupon he presents the Shokan with a weapon forged of order.

After this chain of events, Abacus is seen fighting against his brother Zaggot in a game of chess.
